thread:
olivia: Pushed an updated Figma for the cost panel — new 'bento' layout vs stacked list. Link: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234 (please review quick)

rahul: Browsed it. Nice visual language. Main question: do we prefer a compact bento grid for cross-org glanceability or a stacked project-first list for scan/read flow?

mike: From front-end POV: bento grid is easier for even-width desktop columns, but keyboard/VO needs more work (grid semantics). Stacked list is straightforward for screen readers.

sophie: Accessibility nit: if we go grid, we must expose ARIA roles: role="grid", role="row", role="gridcell" and ensure headers are announced. Also need focusable tiles, not just links inside.

a11y-bot: Contrast warning on accent color #9aaaff used for labels — fails AA for 14px normal text. Recommendation: choose >= 4.5:1 ratio.

olivia: Good catch — swapped to #6F8BF0 in the next frame. Also exploring inline invoice download on each tile vs a global download button in the header. Thoughts?

rahul: Inline download per-tile feels more discoverable for workspace-level invoices, but could clutter. Global CTA is cleaner but less discoverable for specific workspaces. Maybe put a small overflow menu on each tile with "Download" to keep UI tidy.

mike: Overflow menu + ellipsis is easiest to implement. For mobile collapse everything into a single bottom-sheet action. Note on perf: microcharts in every tile (sparklines) could be expensive with many tiles — prefer a single canvas or sprite technique.

sophie: Copy tweak suggestion for the download tooltip: change "Download invoice" -> "Download invoice for this workspace — CSV" (makes scope explicit). Also add aria-label on the button: "Download invoice for <workspace name> as CSV".

olivia: Agreed. Also thinking of adding a 24x48 px token-breakdown microchart in the top-right of tiles (tiny stacked bars). Lightweight sketch included in Figma.

mike: Microcharts ok if rasterized/cached. If we render an SVG per tile for 200 tiles it will spike paint times. Implementation idea: server-side pre-render small PNGs or draw to a single canvas on the client and blit.

rahul: UX concern: when switching scope (Org vs Workspace) the layout currently jumps because header height changes. Proposal: pin the scope toggle in a sticky header so the layout doesn't reflow.

sophie: +1. Also add a keyboard shortcut hint somewhere for power users, e.g., "Press G then W to jump to Workspace view" (mention later if we add shortcuts).

a11y-bot: Keyboard focus order check recommended: ensure tiles receive logical tab order and skip links exist for screen-reader users to jump to the summary table.

olivia: I'll iterate the frames: (1) bento grid with overflow menu, microchart rasterized, accessible roles + pinned scope toggle; (2) stacked list with per-row inline actions and expanded details. Please drop implementation notes below so I can hand off to dev.

mike: Implementation notes: 1) Grid: use CSS grid with tabindex=0 for tile container, manage arrow-key navigation with roving tabindex; 2) Prefetch tiny chart images at low priority; 3) Lazy-load tiles outside viewport; ETA ~2 dev days + 1 for perf/a11y fixes.

sophie: I'll schedule a 30min sync tomorrow to pick between the two and finalize copy. @mike can you bring a quick perf estimate?

mike: Yep — can present rough numbers tomorrow.

olivia: Thanks everyone! I'll post updated frames and add the aria-label text in Figma. :thumbsup:
